title: Infrared Dressing and the Strong CP Problem: Geometric Renormalization of the Vacuum Angle
summary: We revisit the strong CP problem from the viewpoint of the infrared structure of non-Abelian gauge theories. In Yang-Mills theory, motion between topologically inequivalent vacua may be described in terms of a compact collective coordinate associated with the Chern-Simons number. Implementing an adiabatic separation between slow topological modes and fast gluonic fluctuations leads to a reduced Born-Oppenheimer Hamiltonian governing the infrared dynamics.
